headline: TIPAT countries will focus on compliance with rules of origin: Ebrard
summary: Economy Secretary Marcelo Ebrard said TIPAT members are working to prevent illegal triangulation of exports, ensuring shipments carry the correct certificates of origin.
why: Rules of origin determine whether goods qualify for preferential tariff treatment, which matters for manufacturers and exporters in trade blocs.
original_headline: Países del TIPAT se enfocarán en cumplimiento de las reglas de origen: Ebrard
